story.title: Rooted in the Soil of Tharparkar
story.subtitle: Artisanal Wooden Cold-Pressed Oils • Mithi, Sindh
paragraphs: MadhuShud was founded in Mithi, Tharparkar with a singular, uncompromised calling: to bring back the purity of centuries-old Lakri Ghani (traditional wooden cold-press) extraction. In a market saturated with industrially refined, chemically bleached, and high-heat processed oils, we chose the slower, honorable path of zero-heat extraction.

Every harvest of mustard, sesame, coconut, and raw nuts is ethically procured from verified local farmers across Sindh and trusted regional growers. Crushed under slow-turning wooden pestles strictly below 45°C, every bottle retains its therapeutic nutrients, rich golden hue, and virgin aroma — exactly as nature intended.

pillars.title: Traditional Lakri Ghani
pillars.desc: Extracted using slow-moving wooden mortars (Kohlu). Low RPM ensures frictional heat never exceeds 45°C, preserving active vitamins and essential omegas.

pillars.title: Zero Chemical Solvents
pillars.desc: No hexane, no caustic soda bleaching, no deodorizing agents, and no synthetic mineral oil blending. Raw, pure, and 100% unadulterated.

pillars.title: Single-Origin Seeds
pillars.desc: Sourced directly from indigenous Sindh and regional harvests. Triple-cleaned by hand to eliminate impurities before slow pressing.

pillars.title: Multi-Point Lab Verified
pillars.desc: Tested for zero argemone, low peroxide value, and optimal free fatty acid balance. Sealed in dark amber glass to prevent UV photodegradation.

process.title: Seed Selection & Grading
process.desc: Sun-dried indigenous seeds hand-cleaned and triple-sifted for peak oil maturity.

process.title: Slow Wooden Pressing
process.desc: Gentle mechanical crushing in natural timber mortars at low RPM without artificial heat.

process.title: Cotton-Cloth Settling
process.desc: Micro-filtered through multilayer organic cotton cloth. Pure gravity settling, zero bleaching.

process.title: Amber Glass Packaging
process.desc: Bottled in food-grade UV-protective amber containers with tamper-evident security seals.

guarantee.quote: We never bottle or sell what we wouldn't trust for our own children. Every drop of MadhuShud oil carries the honesty, soil, and heritage of Tharparkar.
